introduction: The Physics SBA consists of practical lab exercises covering Mechanics, Thermal Physics, Waves, and Electricity. It accounts for 20% of the grade.

tasks.title: P&D
tasks.explanation: Create an experimental plan to test a physical relationship.

tasks.title: Analysis and Interpretation
tasks.explanation: Analyze data using graphs (calculating gradients) and physical laws.

tasks.title: Reporting
tasks.explanation: Clear presentation of experimental data and conclusions.

sampleTitle: Investigating the relationship between the period of a simple pendulum and its length.

sample.body: The period of the pendulum (T) is proportional to the square root of its length (L). Therefore, a graph of T² against L will be a straight line through the origin.
The gradient of the T² vs L graph was calculated to be 4.02 s²/m. Using the formula g = 4π²/gradient, the acceleration due to gravity was found to be 9.81 m/s².
sample.tips: Show all steps in your gradient calculation.

marking: Attention to significant figures, error bars on graphs, and the identification of systematic/random errors are key for high marks.
checklist: Graph with line of best fit
